name: Tetrahydrocannabihexol
summary: Tetrahydrocannabihexol is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

uses.text: THC-Hexyl can be synthesized from 4-hexylresorcinol and was studied by Roger Adams as early as 1942.

pharmacology.en: It is thought to act like THC, switching on the CB1 and CB2 cannabinoid receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 它被認為與THC作用相似，會活化CB1與CB2大麻素受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它被认为与THC作用相似，会活化CB1与CB2大麻素受体。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. As a THC-like cannabinoid, it would be expected to cause dry mouth, red eyes, a racing heart, anxiety or paranoia, poor short-term memory and impaired coordination.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作為類似THC的大麻素，預期它會造成口乾、眼睛發紅、心跳加速、焦慮或妄想、短期記憶變差與協調受損。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作为类似THC的大麻素，预期它会造成口干、眼睛发红、心跳加速、焦虑或妄想、短期记忆变差与协调受损。

fact.en: Its only difference from THC is a tail one carbon longer, six carbons instead of five. Roger Adams studied it as early as 1942, and it was reported as a trace natural compound in cannabis in 2020.
fact.zh: 四氫大麻己酚與THC唯一的差別是尾鏈多了一個碳，由五個碳變成六個碳。羅傑．亞當斯早在1942年就研究過它，而它在2020年被報導為大麻中微量存在的天然成分。
fact.zhHans: 四氢大麻己酚与THC唯一的差别是尾链多了一个碳，由五个碳变成六个碳。罗杰．亚当斯早在1942年就研究过它，而它在2020年被报导为大麻中微量存在的天然成分。
